name: github-prs
description: GitHub PR-operations skills, each running a bundled script that makes the gh call and re-reads what it changed: create, view, list, diff, update the body of, comment on, and review-submit a PR; flip a PR draft/ready; report a PR's merge readiness and enumerate its merge conflicts; link a PR to the issues it closes via one closing keyword each in the PR body; and report which issues a PR body closes. GitHub-only by design.
